pack.gemini_video_prompt:
### SECTION A: MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK
- Exact Duration: 10.0 seconds total.
- Aspect Ratio: Native Portrait 9:16 (vertical composition only).
- Resolution: 4K photorealistic real-world video footage.
- Target Audience & Setting: Strictly Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

### SECTION B: REALISM LOCK
- 100% photorealistic physical-world footage. No 3D CGI renders, no architectural animations, no cartoon characters, no motion graphic explainers.
- Natural bright morning Tamil Nadu sunlight, authentic Coimbatore atmospheric haze, realistic dust particles near active construction, accurate concrete texture, wet curing marks, authentic TMT rebar sheen, natural shadow angles.

### SECTION C: SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK (OLIVETREE INVESTORS - COIMBATORE)
- Primary Subject: Project Execution Verification and Milestone Tracking in Under-Construction Properties.
- Context: Coimbatore property buyers physically auditing structural slab progress, site labor activity, and connecting roadway infrastructure instead of relying purely on brochure promises.

### SECTION D: SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY
- FORBIDDEN DEFAULT STORY: Do not show an empty plot morphing into a villa or a generic family celebrating on a couch.
- Focus purely on empirical evidence: physical slab casting, rebar tie work, real road traffic adjacency, and construction milestone audit checklists.

### SECTION E: CAMERA & CINEMATOGRAPHY RULES
- Shot with high-end cinema lenses (35mm and 50mm focal lengths).
- Natural, stabilized handheld and subtle dolly movements. No impossible drone zooms, no 360-degree spins, no fast whip pans, no fisheye distortion.

### SECTION F: EXACT 7-SHOT CHRONOLOGICAL PLAN

1. Shot 1 [0.0s - 1.4s] - Tension/Hook
   - Location: Active residential construction site boundary, Coimbatore.
   - Visual: Eye-level vertical view. Foreground shows a hand holding an architectural drawing sheet, framing an authentic multi-storey concrete structural frame under morning light.
   - Text: "Ground Reality"
   - VO (Tamil): "ப்ரோஷர் மட்டும் பாக்காதீங்க!"

2. Shot 2 [1.4s - 2.8s] - Milestone Inspection
   - Location: Mid-level structural deck.
   - Visual: Low-angle vertical tilt up concrete columns, clearly showing physical cast floor slabs with green safety netting on upper framing.
   - Text: "Slab Count"
   - VO (Tamil): "நேர்ல போய் ஸ்லாப் கவுண்ட் செக் பண்ணுங்க."

3. Shot 3 [2.8s - 4.2s] - Labor & Speed Verification
   - Location: Top working slab plate.
   - Visual: Medium shot of workers wearing yellow safety helmets tying structural steel rebar meshes; authentic concrete pump line and equipment visible.
   - Text: "Active Work"
   - VO (Tamil): "வேலை சுறுசுறுப்பா நடக்குதா,"

4. Shot 4 [4.2s - 5.6s] - Infrastructure Proximity
   - Location: Site frontage overlooking access corridor.
   - Visual: Elevated eye-level view showing the direct junction between the project entrance and a wide asphalt Coimbatore connecting road with moving local traffic.
   - Text: "Road Access"
   - VO (Tamil): "ரோடு கனெக்டிவிட்டி சரியா இருக்கான்னு பாருங்க."

5. Shot 5 [5.6s - 7.0s] - Milestone Schedule Audit
   - Location: Site management inspection point.
   - Visual: Crisp macro shot of an evaluation checklist on a hard clipboard with marked milestones, with structural concrete columns in soft background bokeh.
   - Text: "Milestone Check"
   - VO (Tamil): "திட்டமிட்ட முதலீடே"

6. Shot 6 [7.0s - 8.5s] - Structural Quality Confirmation
   - Location: Cured lower floor corridor.
   - Visual: Symmetrical eye-level perspective down a robustly built reinforced concrete column grid, with natural daylight and the distant Western Ghats silhouette visible outside.
   - Text: "Safe Assets"
   - VO (Tamil): "பாதுகாப்பு."

7. Shot 7 [8.5s - 10.0s] - Final Payoff
   - Location: Paved approach at the verified property.
   - Visual: Natural investor walking calmly across the front perimeter of the actively developing project under warm Coimbatore sunlight.
   - Minimal Lower Overlay: "OliveTree Investors"
   - VO (Tamil): "OliveTree Investors."

### SECTION G: NEGATIVE PROMPT & BANNED ELEMENTS
- Ban: 2D/3D cartoon animations, CGI architectural walk-throughs, morphing elements, artificial blueprints floating in air, fake skyscrapers, unverified landmark signs, duplicate crowds, distorted hands, neon title cards.
pack.title_english: How to Verify Under-Construction Projects in Coimbatore
pack.caption_english: Never commit your funds to an under-construction apartment based purely on marketing brochures. Smart real estate investing in Coimbatore demands on-ground verification: count the completed structural slabs, check for active daily labor velocity, and verify true road accessibility at the site gate. Evaluating construction milestones before every payment schedule drastically reduces possession risks. Partner with OliveTree Investors for verified, milestone-backed property investments across Coimbatore.
